text:
sam_sales: Hey @maya_finance — I booked a new flight after the client moved our kickoff. I had to pay a change fee on my personal card ($178.50). Can we get that reimbursed?

maya_finance: Thanks Sam. Can you drop the e-receipt and the original itinerary here? Also need manager sign-off for out-of-policy travel fees > $150.

jordan_travel: FYI, travel ops flagged that the meeting was rescheduled < 24h before flight which is usually reimbursable if approved.

sam_sales: Uploading receipt now — see link: https://files.redwood.example/receipts/1799004567-changefee.jpg (screenshot of charge). Receipt text: "Airline: Skylark Airways
Date: 2026-06-12
Change fee: $178.50
PNR: ABC123"

maya_finance: OK got it. @kevin_mgr can you confirm this was business-needed and approve reimbursement? We need manager approval in thread or an email to finance@redwood.com.

kevin_mgr: Confirmed — client moved call and Sam had to take the earlier flight to keep timeline. Approving reimbursement. :white_check_mark:

maya_finance: Thanks Kevin. Sam, please submit the expense in Ramp under: Expense type = Travel -> Flight change fee, add project tag "client-kairos", attach that receipt, and set payment to "reimburse to card". Note: anything > $150 gets reviewed but approved here.

sam_sales: Done — submitted in Ramp just now. Expense ID RMP-21458.

ramp-bot: Your expense RMP-21458 has been created and routed to Finance for processing. ETA: next payroll cycle or direct ACH if urgent.

maya_finance: We have the Ramp entry and manager approval. We'll process this on the next payroll run; if you need faster please reply with "urgent" and provide last 4 of bank account for ACH.

sam_sales: Not urgent, next payroll is fine. Thanks all. :rocket:
